crops.name: collect/quests_panel
crops.note: The three painted quest cards are erased: the live cards are drawn in their place, and until the day's quests arrived the painting's own -- 'Spend 30 energy, +50 diamonds' -- showed as the player's. The crop starts at the rim's gold line (y 286), and its top corners are cut 12 on the diagonal at the rim's outer shadow line: above and outside the rim is the header's painting, which the header itself draws (to y 292), so with nothing live the tab is as painted -- and under the Crown's event band (collect_events.png) the panel stands 161 lower, where the painting has the dark ground above and beside its rim, not five rows of fields.

crops.name: collect/job_row
crops.note: the name, the counter, the mastery figures and the whole payout band (bolt, coin, crown and their figures) are erased row by row: the row draws the icons live so a long figure can push the next pair along

crops.name: collect/job_frame
crops.note: the grapes row's own steel frame with its window cut out: laid over every job's painting so all fifteen rows wear one frame. The window is x 11..172, y 12..149 of this crop (the painted bevel stays on the frame), its top-left corner chamfered along x + y = 30. The top and left bands end a quarter unit short (11.75, 10.75): the slicer fills a polygon's edge row inclusively, and a band ending on 12 left a quarter of row 12 opaque inside the window. The row's title (GRAPES, from x 354) is erased exactly as collect/job_row erases it: the frame's right band reaches x 358 and would otherwise carry the first sliver of the painted G onto every row.
